title: BPW-2026-0498
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0498
AFE – STATE WATER RESOURCES CONTROL BOARD
Bureau of Sanitation and Office of Accounting are requesting Board approval and execution of an Authority for Expenditure in the amount of $250,000 for encumbrance of funds to pay annual National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System permit and all other fees associated with and required by the California State Water Resources Control Board for the period of July 1, 2026 thru June 30, 2027. Authorize the President or two members of the Board of Public Works to execute this service agreement.
(AE27760516M, Fund 760 - Sewer Operations & Maintenance Fund, Dept. 50, Appropriation Unit 50EX82)
